# flexcyon

flexcyon combines the color schemes of Halcyon and Flexoki in one Obsidian theme. Its recorded description names terminal-inspired aesthetics, sane defaults and extensive customisation through Style Settings, and refers to separate documentation whose contents are not part of the recorded inputs.

![flexcyon screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bladeacer/flexcyon/HEAD/./docs/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "flexcyon"
    author: "bladeacer"
    repo:   "bladeacer/flexcyon"
    slug:   "flexcyon"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/flexcyon"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bladeacer/flexcyon"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bladeacer/flexcyon/HEAD/./docs/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "An Obsidian.md theme combining the colour schemes of Halcyon and Flexoki. Featuring terminal inspired aesthetics, sane defaults and extensive customisation options via Style Settings. Read the documentation to find out more."
}
```
